title: Transforming cancer treatment: Integrative strategies targeting the tumor microenvironment through biological innovation and artificial intelligence.
snippet: Cancer is no longer viewed solely as a consequence of tumor-intrinsic genetic alterations but rather as a disease sustained by a complex and evolving tumor microenvironment (TME).
